limitations: All graphics, glyph masks, 60 morphing shapes, 6000 particle objects, point sphere and trefoil, signed-distance shader blobs and UI are independently editable code. No source frame, screenshot texture or video is used in the visual runtime.

Point trajectories, sphere mesh and trefoil topology, shader reflections/refraction and deformations, fonts, grain/glitch and exact subframe cuts remain reconstructed approximations. The shader uses a real 96-step SDF march but does not recover the original author algorithm.
HUD preserves the 1080x1920 60fps original reference framing; export is 720x1280 at 30fps.
